provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A project helper whose name merely ends in "require" is not the CommonJS loader.

groundTruth.rationale: myrequire is a project-local function, not the module loader, so the dynamic-require rule must not fire; this pins the identifier boundary added on 2026-10-19.

limitations: Name-based boundary check only; whether myrequire itself loads modules is outside the line.
